Ontology_TreatmentAndDesign_prompt.notes: The proteomics experiment (LC-MS/MS) was performed on 60 PDAC patient-derived xenografts (PDXs) to establish baseline ubiquitination profiles. While the study later uses these profiles to correlate with drug resistance (gemcitabine, 5-FU, oxaliplatin, irinotecan), the MS analysis itself was not a treatment-vs-control experiment but a profiling of the disease state. The in vivo chemoresistance tests mentioned in the text were separate phenotypic assays used to generate resistance scores for bioinformatics correlation, not the primary perturbation for the MS sample preparation.
